errors.not_pending: Request is not in pending status

validation.reject_reason_string: Reject reason must be a string
validation.limit_positive: Limit must be a positive number

list.summary: Get list of organization update requests
list.description: Get list of organization update requests with pagination and status filtering. Requires `organization.update_request.list` permission.

read.description: Get detailed information of an update request including organization and requester info. Requires `organization.update_request.read` permission.

approve.description: Approve an organization update request. After approval, the organization information will be updated accordingly. Requires `organization.update_request.approve` permission.

reject.description: Reject an organization update request with a rejection reason. Requires `organization.update_request.reject` permission.
